title: Pin the frozen latent-ceiling source revision before claims
finding: The experiment froze the denominator but accepted any syntactically valid 40-hex source_revision. A complete measured corpus could therefore publish a ceiling while identifying a different repository revision than the preregistered failure corpus measured on 29/30 July, weakening revision-bound evidence identity.
primary_claim: The latent-ceiling file boundary now refuses any source_revision other than the preregistered frozen revision, and direct evaluation cannot mark a corpus complete or emit a numeric ceiling when its revision identity differs even if all 1,383 measured rows are present.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing frozen-corpus guard path with one revision constant. Do not introduce a corpus registry, revision service, schema framework, migration layer, embedding service, vector store, or second experiment identity model.
acceptance: the committed prediction-only corpus remains valid, incomplete, and bound to the preregistered source revision
a changed but syntactically valid source revision is refused at the file boundary
a programmatically constructed complete 1,383-row corpus with a changed source revision cannot publish a ceiling
the existing frozen denominator guard and malformed-corpus refusals remain unchanged
a complete measured corpus on the frozen revision still computes present_not_expressible / 1383
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.local_exact_blob_result: 19 passed in 0.09s; py_compile succeeded; prediction-only CLI emitted ceiling=null and exit 3
verification.hosted_ci: unclaimed unless an exact-head workflow run appears after push
verification.claim: Only checks tied to the recorded exact blobs/head count as green evidence; no full-repository, package, platform, latent-benefit, or benchmark claim follows.

rollback: Revert the G1-EXP-TENSOR-LATENT-CEILING-05 commits; the experiment remains prediction-only and no production Tensor/embedding authority is affected.
